reason: Complete strategy: (a) transport admissible metrics by a biholomorphism, using det Df = |f'|^2 and the published nonnegative change-of-variables formula, and reverse the roles of f and f^{-1}; (b) immediate from inf/sup over a larger path class; (c) the series law by normalising metrics with l=A=lambda on disjoint carriers and testing rho = max(rho_0,rho_1); (d) the parallel (Grotzsch) law by restriction to the supports plus area additivity. Examined deps include def-biholomorphic-map, cor-jacobian-determinant-of-a-holomorphic-map, lem-c-one-change-of-variables-for-nonnegative-borel-functions-via-radon-uniqueness, def-countable-choice (published). Sources: Bishop Lemmas 1.1-1.5 and Cor. 1.4; Lyubich 6.2; Ahlfors-Beurling Lemmas 1-3.
